_comment: Curated festival/season calendar seeded for the next ~6 months. Dates marked 'verify': true are approximate solar/lunar estimates — confirm against a current calendar before relying on them. recurringRule formats used by the service: 'MM-DD' = every year on that date; 'MM-DD:MM-DD' = every-year date range.
